name: facebookresearch_nocturne/scripts/json_generation/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_nocturne/scripts/json_g.run_make_solvable_files: run the script to find Waymo scenarios where agents must collide with road edges to reach their goal

facebookresearch_nocturne/scripts/json_g.run_train_data_validation: run the script with --datatype train to validate only training data scenarios for solvability
facebookresearch_nocturne/scripts/json_g.run_valid_data_validation: run the script with --datatype valid to validate only validation data scenarios for solvability

facebookresearch_nocturne/scripts/json_g.run_no_traffic_light_filter: run the Waymo JSON generator excluding scenarios that contain traffic lights
facebookresearch_nocturne/scripts/json_g.run_single_file_conversion: run the Waymo TFRecord converter on a single specified file and output to current directory
facebookresearch_nocturne/scripts/json_g.run_full_dataset_conversion: run the Waymo JSON generator to iterate through and convert the entire training or validation dataset

facebookresearch_nocturne/scripts/json_g.load_protobuf: load Waymo scenario protobufs from a TFRecord file and yield each scenario
facebookresearch_nocturne/scripts/json_g.waymo_to_scenario: convert a Waymo scenario protobuf to a JSON file with objects, roads, and traffic light states
facebookresearch_nocturne/scripts/json_g.parse_object_state: parse a Waymo object state protobuf into a dict with position, heading, velocity, and goal
facebookresearch_nocturne/scripts/json_g.init_object: construct a dict representing the trajectory and type of a tracked vehicle, cyclist, or pedestrian
facebookresearch_nocturne/scripts/json_g.init_road: convert a Waymo map feature protobuf into a dict with geometry coordinates and feature type
